questions.stem: How many days are there in a leap year?

hint.level_0: An ordinary year and a leap year differ by exactly one day. Which one is asked about?
hint.level_1: An ordinary year has 365 days. In a leap year, February gets one extra day.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a leap year?

hint.level_0: What makes a year a leap year? Recall the rule before checking the choices.
hint.level_1: Rule: the year must divide exactly by 4. BUT century years (ending 00) must divide by 400.
hint.level_2: Test each choice: divide by 4 (and by 400 if it ends in 00). Which one passes? = ?

questions.stem: If January 1 is a Monday, what day is January 31?

hint.level_0: We know January 1 is a Monday, and we want the weekday of January 31.
hint.level_1: Weekdays repeat every 7 days. Count how many days lie between January 1 and January 31, then find the remainder after dividing by 7.
hint.level_2: Move that remainder of days forward from Monday: Monday + remainder days = ?
